about: Where the study site is published. The cloud orchestrator refreshes these at the end of every iteration (see .claude/skills/study-session/SKILL.md, step Ship).

github_pages.how: .github/workflows/pages.yml builds the site with tools/publish/build-site.mjs and force-pushes it to the gh-pages branch on every push to the study branch whose commit message does not start with WIP, if npm test passes.

google_drive.account_note: The Drive connector in the cloud session is signed in to the account that owns this folder.
google_drive.how: The cloud session recreates the 'Start here' doc each iteration with the Drive connector (create the new one, trash the old one, update start_doc_id). Videos are copied into the folder by the local agent, because large files cannot go through the connector.

claude_artifact.how: Republish from build/site after every iteration: node tools/publish/build-site.mjs, then node tools/publish/artifact-page.mjs build/site/index.html <scratch>/index.html, and publish that page with every other file under build/site passed through `files` (same relative paths). Use the same scratch file path in the same session to keep the URL; from another session pass this url.
